description: This file defines the CircularPriorityQueue class, a generic data structure implementing a priority queue with a fixed maximum size, supporting concurrent operations, and maintaining insertion order and sorted order.

classes.name: CircularPriorityQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe, size-limited priority queue that maintains insertion order and sorted order, supporting concurrent modifications and retrievals.

methods.name: CircularPriorityQueue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the queue with maximum size, comparator, and key functions.

methods.name: setMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the queue.

methods.name: removePriorityKey
methods.description: Removes a priority key associated with an element.

methods.name: addPriorityKey
methods.description: Adds a priority key for an element.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the queue, maintaining size constraints.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an element from the queue.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the queue.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of elements in sorted order.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves an element by its key.

methods.name: keyMap
methods.description: Returns a map of keys to elements.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: toSortedList
methods.description: Returns a list of elements in sorted order.
